Class DbCurve

java.lang.Object
  |

Direct Known Subclasses:
DbArc, DbLine
public class DbCurve
extends DbEntity

The class DbEntity is the abstract base class from which all other entity classes are derived. This class serves as a proxy to the the actual database entity. Being an abstract class, you can not instantiate an instance of DbEntity.
